shorts.title: What you will learn: Two-dimensional arrays
shorts.hook: Rows and columns, in two lines of code.
shorts.script: Rows and columns, in two lines of code. Today we make a table. A two-dimensional array has rows and columns, like a cinema seat plan. A two-dimensional array is an array of rows. Each row is an array of columns. You need two indexes. The first is the row, and the second is the column. In memory, the rows sit one after another. Keep coding, says Xecxec!
shorts.caption: What you will learn: Two-dimensional arrays.

shorts.title: Two-dimensional arrays in one minute
shorts.hook: A two-dimensional array is an array of rows.
shorts.script: A two-dimensional array is an array of rows. Each row is an array of columns. You need two indexes. The first is the row, and the second is the column. In memory, the rows sit one after another. Think of a cinema seat plan. To find your seat, you need a row and a seat number. Two rows and three columns. Keep coding, says Xecxec!
shorts.caption: Two-dimensional arrays in one minute.

shorts.title: Inside the second program
shorts.hook: The outer loop picks the row.
shorts.script: The outer loop picks the row. Each row starts with a new sum of zero. The inner loop visits the three columns. Each cell is added to the sum. Row zero sums to six. Row one sums to fifteen. The program prints Row zero colon six, and Row one colon fifteen. A two-dimensional array has rows and columns. Keep coding, says Xecxec!
shorts.caption: Inside the second program.

shorts.title: Bug of the Day: A missing column size
shorts.hook: Can you spot the bug in two-dimensional arrays?
shorts.script: Can you spot the bug in two-dimensional arrays? Bug of the Day. Both sizes are empty. The compiler says multidimensional array must have bounds for all dimensions except the first. It can count the rows from your list. But it needs the column size. Write the number two in the second brackets. The compiler can count the rows from your list. Keep coding, says Xecxec!
shorts.caption: Bug of the Day: A missing column size.

shorts.title: Pun and challenge
shorts.hook: Can you print a multiplication grid in two-dimensional arrays?
shorts.script: Can you print a multiplication grid in two-dimensional arrays? I made a grid of jokes. Every row had a punchline, and every column had a groan. Make a two by two grid with the numbers one, two, three and four. Print the diagonal: row zero column zero, and row one column one. Write your answer in the comments. Keep coding, says Xecxec!
shorts.caption: Pun and challenge.
